name: overthink
description: An open-source sandbox for testing AI in a business environment. Overthought & Co., a simulated company whose apps all work, plus the tools for your coding agent to create activity, move time, observe and reset.
author: Expanza Limited

scripts.check: node bin/ensure-world.mjs --all && npm test && npm run validate && npm run scenarios:check
scripts.test: node --test infrastructure/engine/engine.test.js business/builder/world/world.test.mjs examples/benchmark/score.test.mjs infrastructure/server/server.test.mjs infrastructure/server/security.test.mjs infrastructure/server/jobs.test.mjs examples/benchmark/bench.test.mjs simulation/simulator/sim.test.mjs simulation/simulator/core.test.mjs simulation/simulator/live.test.mjs simulation/simulator/facts.test.mjs infrastructure/engine/levers.test.js simulation/simulator/gaps.test.mjs infrastructure/engine/comms.test.js infrastructure/engine/events.test.js simulation/world/world.test.mjs simulation/world/population.test.mjs simulation/lab/lab.test.mjs infrastructure/server/explore.test.mjs infrastructure/engine/business.test.js simulation/simulator/team.test.mjs 'activity-generation/**/*.test.ts' 'infrastructure/**/*.test.ts' 'integrations/**/*.test.ts' 'observability/**/*.test.ts' 'simulation/**/*.test.ts' 'tests/**/*.test.ts' 'applications/**/*.test.mjs'
scripts.world: node business/builder/build-world.mjs --size demo && node business/builder/build-world.mjs --size standard && node business/builder/build-world.mjs --size demo --stories && node business/builder/build-world.mjs --size standard --stories && node business/builder/build-knowledge.mjs
scripts.validate: node business/builder/validate.mjs --size demo && node business/builder/validate.mjs --size standard && node business/builder/validate.mjs --size demo --bench && node business/builder/validate.mjs --size standard --bench
